newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria sells 28.22 bln levs 1- and 4-wk T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria sells 28.22 bln levs 1- and 4-wk T-bills.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry on Tuesday sold two discount T-bill issues with maturities of one week and four weeks, yielding 3.84 percent and 17.70 percent to maturity, respectively, the central bank said.
Bids were received for a total of 28.217 billion levs of T-bills and the ministry approved all the bids.
The issues were offered with no par value or minimum acceptable price set in advance by the ministry. Auction date and maturity date for each issue overlap.
Details of the issues follow. Prices are in percent of par:
Bids received 12,864.1 million levs 15,353.2 million levs
Bids approved 12,864.1 million levs 15,353.2 million levs
Avg yield to maturity 3.84 pct 17.70 pct
